metadata.title: Create High-Level Plan
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Generate a comprehensive task plan with complexity ratings, LLD, and Q&A for missing information. Use when starting a user story implementation.

output.description: High-level plan document with LLD and complexity-rated steps

prerequisites: User story context with title, description, and acceptance criteria
specificActions: Gather Requirements: Extract user story title, description, and acceptance criteria; identify affected components (API, Service, Repository, etc.); understand the feature's purpose and goals

Identify Missing Information: Check for external APIs, infrastructure setup, third-party libraries, business rules, data structures; list assumptions needing user confirmation; create Q&A section with specific questions - do not proceed with LLD until answers provided
Wait for Q&A Answers (if needed): Present the plan with Q&A section to the user; wait for explicit answers to all questions; update the plan with provided information

Create Low Level Design (after Q&A resolved): Document current system design with diagrams; document proposed changes with diagrams; show data flow, component interactions, architectural patterns; include class diagrams, sequence diagrams as appropriate

Break Down into Major Steps: Identify all major implementation steps; typical pattern: API Layer → Service Layer → Repository Layer → Unit Tests → Integration Tests → Documentation; rate complexity for each step (1-9 scale); steps with complexity 7+ must be flagged for further breakdown
Identify Required Process-Steps: For each implementation step, determine which process-step will execute it; check if required process-steps exist; list any missing process-steps
Present Plan for Approval: Present complete plan to user; wait for approval before proceeding; IMMEDIATELY log user interaction
bestPractices: Never assume unspecified information - create Q&A section instead
Wait for Q&A answers before completing LLD
Flag complexity 7+ steps for further breakdown

substeps.name: Init-Step: Confirm Principles
substeps.description: Recall operating principles before starting this step
actions: Read `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md` and recall all principles
Output: '✓ Principles confirmed for this step'

substeps.name: Gather requirements from user story context
substeps.description: Extract user story title, description, acceptance criteria and identify affected components
actions: Extract user story title, description, and acceptance criteria
Identify affected components (API, Service, Repository, etc.)
Understand the feature's purpose and goals

substeps.name: Identify missing information and create Q&A section
substeps.description: Check for missing information and create Q&A section with specific questions
actions: Check for: external APIs, infrastructure setup, third-party libraries, business rules, data structures
List any assumptions that need user confirmation
Create Q&A section with specific questions - do not proceed with LLD until answers provided

substeps.name: Wait for Q&A answers
substeps.description: Present plan with Q&A section and wait for user answers
actions: Present the plan with Q&A section to the user
Wait for explicit answers to all questions
Update the plan with provided information

substeps.name: Create Low Level Design with diagrams
substeps.description: Document current and proposed system design with appropriate diagrams
actions: Document current system design with diagrams
Document proposed changes with diagrams
Show data flow, component interactions, architectural patterns
Include class diagrams, sequence diagrams as appropriate

substeps.name: Break down into complexity-rated steps
substeps.description: Identify all major implementation steps and rate complexity
actions: Identify all major implementation steps
Typical pattern: API Layer → Service Layer → Repository Layer → Unit Tests → Integration Tests → Documentation
Rate complexity for each step (1-9 scale)
Steps with complexity 7+ must be flagged for further breakdown

substeps.name: Identify and validate required process-steps
substeps.description: Map implementation steps to process-steps and check existence
actions: For each implementation step, determine which process-step will execute it
Check if required process-steps exist in .processes/steps/
List any missing process-steps

substeps.name: Present plan for approval
substeps.description: Present complete plan to user and wait for approval
actions: Present complete plan to user
Wait for approval before proceeding
IMMEDIATELY log user interaction

substeps.name: Process approval response
substeps.description: Handle user's approval, modification request, or rejection
actions: If approved: Update process.md Implementation Steps section with actual tasks from approved plan
If modification requested: Revise plan based on feedback and re-present
If rejected: Document rejection reason and stop

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Verify: Do modified process files conform to type definitions? (Principle 7 - see `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md`)
Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Gather requirements → Identify missing info → Q&A (if needed) → Create LLD → Break down steps → Identify process-steps → Present for approval → Process response

fields: Information Produced: Plan directory path, Q&A status, Implementation steps summary, Process-steps validation results
Decisions Made: Complexity ratings, Process-step mappings
